comments.author: Rhend
comments.body: Thinking of going for the Augmented Golden Hind. Question, does the defensive bonus fron APN and WMB stack? Considering taking WMB as the fusion inherited skill to help with the small amount of men, then going Roaring Sea-mines and heavy bomb as the original. Wondering how this would stack up for all around fighting, from piracy, to BHing to fighting in ESF's and such.

comments.author: MarcoS
comments.body: yes APN+WMB stacks, just a little info if the enemy has higher crew than you and WMB, even if you're both 0 crew ability the higher crewed ship will get WMB and you wont, so might wanna go for +30 crew at G3. personally i think if youre adding HB to original i think id go for SMineRemoval instead of WMB. unless you plan an aide ship to have sea mine search but its still risky especially in ESF with everyone spamming RSM.

comments.author: Rhend
comments.body: Hmmm, ok, ty much for the info. Is Sea mine removal a skill you must activate, or is it a passive skill?
